_help: Newest first. Keep them short and vague. tag: released | progress | coming.

updates.title: v0.2.4: Reach check
updates.text: See how far your messages get: gateways that upload them to MQTT are counted by hops, on the radio and in a new Reach logger on the web page. MQTT can now be set up on the radio itself. Also fixes the V4-R8 SD card slot and some overlapping text.

updates.title: Hoptics for MeshCore
updates.text: A big-screen version for the CrowPanel 10.1 is being built. More to share soon.

updates.title: More nodes
updates.text: T-Deck Plus and ThinkNode M9 builds are being tested, reach check included. They appear here once checked on the hardware.
